starting.card: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire

description: hey everyone,I was thinking a couple of days ago on how to combine these two great decks, here is what I got
cards: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire
posted: Something special splanned for them
posted: Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand
posted: SFS L-s9.3 laser cannons (THE SE ONE)
notes: Starting cards in the post's 'Start (6)' section: Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire ('Rops/ITHOTE'), Ralltiir, Prepared Defenses, Something Special Planned For Them, Mobilization Points, You Cannot Hide Forever ('YCHF'); they count toward the 60. No starting Effect is singled out.
The 'Red (17)' and 'Blue (13)' headers are the post's names for Interrupts/Effects and Starships; the draft's 'Red' row was a header and was dropped. Sections total 6+4+17+17+13+3 = 60.
Ralltiir, Forest, Swamp and Jungle dested the Dark pages (Ralltiir (Dark), Forest (Dark), Swamp (Dark), Jungle (Dark)).
Posted 'mara jades stick' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'vaders sick' dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere); 'darth vader' dested Darth Vader (Premiere).

Posted spellings corrected: 'Troop davin Felth' = Trooper Davin Felth; 'Emperor Palpitine' = Emperor Palpatine; 'Imperial barriar' = Imperial Barrier; 'Devastor' = Devastator; 'Chimera' = Chimaera; 'The Emperors sheild' = The Emperor's Shield; 'Something special splanned for them' = Something Special Planned For Them.
Posted 'SFS L-s9.3 laser cannons (THE SE ONE)' = SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons (Special Edition).
Byline handle 'Your mom' is the same handle as on the existing Wilson Fisher page; credited by real name.
